description: NZ Building Outlines, published by Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, gives current two-dimensional roof outlines of buildings in mainland New Zealand, classified from LINZ aerial imagery through automated and manual processes. Outlines of 10 square metres or more are captured, including garages and large sheds, and each carries a building id, name and use where known, suburb, town and territorial authority, capture method and the imagery source and dates. Coverage: nearly all regions, except parts of the Southern Alps, Fiordland, Stewart Island and the Chatham Islands; the layer held 3,236,141 polygons on 26 September 2026. Access: the LINZ Data Service with its APIs and OGC services, and ArcGIS Online and REST services. A companion layer, NZ Building Outlines (All Sources), keeps every outline with the dates it existed. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: outlines only show buildings present when each region was last flown, which happens every few years, and the lifecycle table linking split and merged outlines stopped updating in January 2025. Simulation uses are a national building footprint layer for earthquake, flood, tsunami and landslide exposure and for emergency planning. Related records: the Microsoft global building footprints and Google Open Buildings.
